name: Jeeter | Maui Wowie | 2G Liquid Diamond XL All-In-One Vape
description: Maui Wowie (not Maui Waui) is a classic sativa with tropical flavors that transport you straight to the shores of Hawaii, where this iconic strain was born. First cultivated in the island’s volcanic soil, Maui Wowie has spread far and wide, known for its sweet pineapple taste and vibrant citrus-earthy aroma. Light and breezy, this strain captures the spirit of island living and pairs perfectly with sunshine and playlists.
